voice.steering: Speak in an intimate, reflective, biographical portrait narration tone.

world_anchor: Historical biography, archival human portraits and memoirs
style_block: Shot on medium format camera, portrait photography with shallow depth of field, directional window light, rich tonal contrast, refined classic grain.
negative_block: No cartoon elements, no exaggerated plastic face smoothing, no sci-fi neon, no text, no watermark, no signature, no logo.

portrait_archive.prompt: Medium format archival portrait, warm window light, silver halide grain, sitter turned slightly off-camera.

family_album.prompt: Aged family album page, overlapping deckle-edged snapshots on black card.

oil_portrait.prompt: Classical oil portrait, visible brushwork, dark umber ground, museum lighting.

study_silhouette.prompt: Figure silhouetted at a tall study window, dust suspended in the light shaft.

newsprint_profile.prompt: Halftone newspaper profile photograph, coarse dot screen, feature-page crop.
